blocks.text: Gas transport (gases ka ek jagah se doosri jagah le jaya jana) respiration ka zaroori hissa hai. Oxygen lungs se jism ke tamam tissues tak jati hai aur usi waqt carbon dioxide tissues se lungs tak aati hai. Neeche bataya gaya hai ke insaan ke jism mein gases kaise le jayi jati hain.
Oxygen ka transport

Alveoli mein oxygen ka partial pressure (hawa ke kul pressure mein oxygen ka hissa) oxygen ko alveoli se pulmonary capillaries mein diffuse hone deta hai. Khoon mein thodi si oxygen plasma mein ghul jati hai. Plasma zyada se zyada taqreeban 3 mL O₂ fi litre ghol sakta hai, magar poora khoon taqreeban 200 mL O₂ fi litre le jata hai! Wajah yeh hai ke zyada tar oxygen plasma mein ghuli nahi hoti balke RBCs ke andar haemoglobin ke molecules se judi hoti hai.

blocks.title: Naliyan surkh aur neeli kyun dikhai jati hain
blocks.text: Oxyhaemoglobin (oxygen wala haemoglobin) chamakdar surkh aur deoxyhaemoglobin (oxygen ke baghair) gehra surkh hota hai, magar deoxyhaemoglobin tissues ko halka neela rang deta hai. Isi liye diagrams mein oxygen wala khoon le jane wali naliyan surkh aur oxygen se khali khoon wali naliyan neeli dikhai jati hain.

Samundar ki satah par alveoli mein oxygen ka partial pressure taqreeban 105 mm Hg hai, jo bahar ki hawa se kam hai. Phir bhi RBCs ka taqreeban 97% haemoglobin oxygen se jud kar oxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai, jis ka rang tamatar ke juice jaisa chamakdar surkh hai. Khoon capillaries se guzarta hai to kuch oxyhaemoglobin oxygen chhod kar gehre surkh rang ka deoxyhaemoglobin ban jata hai. Is liye jab khoon tissue se veins mein nikalta hai to us mein oxygen ka partial pressure kam (40 mm Hg) hota hai. Yahan 75% haemoglobin abhi bhi oxyhaemoglobin hota hai. Yani 22% (97% − 75%) oxyhaemoglobin ne apni oxygen tissues ko de di, aur 75% oxyhaemoglobin khoon mein zakheere (reserve) ke tor par bacha rehta hai. Yeh bada zakheera aaram aur warzish (exercise) dono mein jism ki oxygen ki zaroorat poori karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke “78% oxyhaemoglobin” zakheere mein bachta hai. Kitab ke apne adad se 97% − 22% = 75% banta hai, yani zakheera 75% hai, 78% nahi.
Oxygen ke transport par asar dalne wali cheezein

Warzish mein muscles capillaries ke khoon se zyada oxygen le leti hain. Is se veins ke khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure 20 mm Hg tak gir jata hai, aur haemoglobin ki saturation (oxygen se bhara hona) 75% se 35% par aa jati hai. Arteries ke khoon mein ab bhi 97% oxyhaemoglobin hai, is liye ab 62% (97% − 35%) oxygen tissues ko milti hai, aaram ke 22% ke bajaye.

blocks.title: Zakheere ka faida
blocks.text: Oxygen ke is zakheere ki wajah se agar saans ruk jaye ya dil pump karna band kar de to bhi khoon mein chaar se paanch minute tak zindagi ke liye kaafi oxygen hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen pattiyan jo haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (saturation) dikhati hain: arterial khoon, PO2 105 mm Hg par 97%; aaram mein venous khoon, PO2 40 mm Hg par 75% (22% utri); warzish mein venous khoon, PO2 20 mm Hg par 35% (62% utri). Neeche 0 se 100% ka paimana hai.
blocks.caption: Mukhtalif PO2 par haemoglobin ki oxygen se sairi (matn ke aadad se asal chart; kitab mein yahan koi figure nahin).

blocks.text: Tissues ki banai hui CO₂ khoon ka pH kam karti hai (khoon thoda tezabi hota hai). Kam pH par haemoglobin ki oxygen se affinity (pakad) kam ho jati hai, is liye woh oxygen aasani se chhod deta hai. pH ke is asar ko Bohr effect kehte hain. Temperature barhne ka bhi yahi asar hai. Warzish mein skeletal muscles zyada garmi banati hain, is liye haemoglobin zyada oxygen chhodta hai.
Carbon dioxide ka transport

Blood capillaries tissues ko oxygen deti hain aur un se carbon dioxide le leti hain. Tissues mein CO₂ ka partial pressure khoon se zyada hota hai, is liye CO₂ tissues se khoon mein aa jati hai. Lungs mein ulta hota hai: alveoli mein CO₂ ka partial pressure khoon se kam hota hai. Khoon CO₂ ko tissues se lungs tak teen tareeqon se le jata hai.
1- Bicarbonate ions ki shakal mein

Taqreeban 72% CO₂ khoon mein bicarbonate ions ki shakal mein jati hai. CO₂ RBCs mein ja kar enzyme carbonic anhydrase ki madad se pani se mil kar carbonic acid (H₂CO₃) banati hai. Carbonic acid toot kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur bicarbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) bana deta hai. Hydrogen ion oxyhaemoglobin se jud jata hai aur oxyhaemoglobin ki oxygen tissue ko mil jati hai. Bicarbonate ions RBCs se nikal kar plasma mein chale jate hain. Is mein ek transporter madad karta hai jo ek bicarbonate ion ke badle ek chloride ion (Cl⁻) andar laata hai; ise “chloride shift” ya “Hamburger phenomenon” kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ ⇌ H⁺ + HCO₃⁻ (carbonic anhydrase)

blocks.title: Acid-base balance
blocks.text: Carbonic acid ka banna khoon ka acid-base balance (tezabi aur alkaline hone ka tawazun) qaim rakhne mein aham hai, kyunke bicarbonate plasma ka sab se bada buffer (pH ko sambhalne wala) hai.
2- Carbaminohaemoglobin ki shakal mein
Taqreeban 20% CO₂ haemoglobin se jud kar jati hai. CO₂ haemoglobin ki globin (protein) chains se jud jati hai; is jode ko carbaminohaemoglobin kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is ko “carboxyhaemoglobin” likha hai. Sahi naam carbaminohaemoglobin hai (CO₂ + haemoglobin ki globin chains). Carboxyhaemoglobin carbon monoxide (CO) aur haemoglobin ka jod hai, jo CO poisoning mein banta hai.

blocks.title: O₂ aur CO₂ muqabla kyun nahi karte
blocks.text: CO₂ haemoglobin ke protein hisse se judti hai aur O₂ haem ke iron se. Is liye dono haemoglobin par jagah ke liye aapas mein muqabla nahi karte.
3- Plasma mein ghuli hui CO₂
Jab CO₂ khoon mein aati hai to thodi si plasma ke pani mein ghul jati hai. Taqreeban 8% CO₂ isi tarah jati hai.

Khoon CO₂ ko in teeno shaklon mein lungs tak lata hai. Alveoli ki hawa mein CO₂ ka partial pressure (PCO₂) kam hota hai, is liye H₂CO₃ wapas H₂O aur CO₂ mein badal jata hai. CO₂ khoon se alveoli mein diffuse ho jati hai aur agli saans ke saath jism se nikal jati hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Tissue wala sira: tissue cells ki carbon dioxide capillary ki deewar paar karti hai; kuch plasma mein ghulti hai, kuch red blood cells mein ja kar haemoglobin se jurti hai, aur kuch pani se mil kar (carbonic anhydrase) carbonic acid banati hai jo hydrogen ions (Hb se jurte hain) aur bicarbonate ions deta hai; bicarbonate RBC se nikalta hai aur chloride andar aata hai. Alveoli wala sira: yahi reactions ulti chalti hain aur carbon dioxide alveoli mein nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tissue par CO₂ ke teen raste: plasma mein ghulna (taqreeban 8%), haemoglobin se judna (taqreeban 20%) aur bicarbonate banna (taqreeban 72%). HCO₃⁻ bahar jata hai to barabari ke liye Cl⁻ andar aata hai; ise chloride shift kehte hain. Lungs mein sab ulta hota hai aur CO₂ saans ke saath nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Carbon monoxide poisoning (CO ka zehar)
blocks.text: Lakdi, petrol, propane ya qudrati gas jaise eendhan poori tarah na jalein to CO gas banti hai. Band kamre mein gas heater raat bhar jalta rahe to CO kamre mein jama ho jati hai. Saans ke saath andar ja kar CO haemoglobin se oxygen ke muqable mein kahin zyada mazbooti se judti hai. Is se oxygen le jane ke liye haemoglobin kam bachta hai aur tissues ko oxygen nahi milti (hypoxia). Yahi CO poisoning hai. Alamaat: sar dard, chakkar, kamzori, matli (nausea), uljhan (confusion), saans phoolna, seene ka dard aur behoshi. Shadeed halat mein dimagh ko hamesha ka nuqsan aur maut bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Daudne wale ki taang ki muscles garam hain aur bohat CO₂ bana rahi hain. Kitab ke adad se batayein ke wahan khoon aaram ke muqable mein kitni zyada oxygen chhodta hai, aur kyun.
blocks.explanation: Aaram mein veins ke khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure 40 mm Hg hai, haemoglobin 75% bhara rehta hai aur sirf 22% oxygen chhodta hai. Warzish mein muscles yeh pressure 20 mm Hg tak gira deti hain, saturation 35% reh jati hai aur 62% oxygen milti hai, yani taqreeban teen guna. Zyada CO₂ pH kam karti hai aur garmi temperature barhati hai; dono haemoglobin ki oxygen se pakad kam karte hain (Bohr effect), is liye oxygen wahin zyada chhoot-ti hai jahan zaroorat hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Oxygen: plasma sirf taqreeban 3 mL fi litre gholta hai, poora khoon taqreeban 200 mL le jata hai kyunke haemoglobin oxygen se judta hai. Arteries ka khoon 97% bhara (105 mm Hg); aaram mein veins ka 75% (40 mm Hg), yani 22% oxygen di gayi aur 75% zakheera; warzish mein 35% (20 mm Hg) aur 62% di gayi. Kam pH (Bohr effect) aur garmi haemoglobin se zyada oxygen chhudwate hain.

Carbon dioxide: 72% bicarbonate (carbonic anhydrase, chloride shift), 20% globin chains se judi (carbaminohaemoglobin), 8% plasma mein ghuli; lungs mein sab ulta. Bicarbonate plasma ka buffer hai. CO haemoglobin se mazbooti se jud kar hypoxia karti hai.
